mahalaya.title: Mahalaya — মহালয়া
mahalaya.significance: End of Pitru Paksha (Sep 26 – Oct 10) and the eve of Devi Paksha. Traditionally the day Bengalis invoke Maa Durga with 'Ya Devi Sarvabhuteshu' and listen to Birendra Krishna Bhadra's Mahishasuramardini broadcast at dawn.
mahalaya.mahishasuramardini: Since 1931 (except a brief substitution in 1976), All India Radio has broadcast Birendra Krishna Bhadra's Mahishasuramardini — Chandipath and songs — at 4 AM on Mahalaya morning.
mahalaya.tarpan: Many perform Mahalaya tarpan for ancestors on Sarva Pitru Amavasya before the festive fortnight begins.
